verdicts._note: Ruling R10 (Christopher 2026-10-27): the preamble introduces only the compound (含有<data>封包, no 的); a shortened name of an introduced compound has no basis, so every 該封包 is a finding. Surfaced by the 封包 lexeme guard (the old trailing 包 strip cut the reference to one character and dropped it). Claim-read 2026-10-27.
所述封包 in claim 27: the chain introduces only 第一封包 (claim 19), never a bare packet, so the reference is ambiguous. Surfaced by the 封包 lexeme guard. Claim-read 2026-10-27.

Ruling R11 (Christopher 2026-10-27, TW): dropping 的 changes the name. Claim 1 introduces 已包裝的資料; the later 該(所接收的)已包裝資料 has no basis. Surfaced when 該所V的X stopped introducing itself. Claim-read 2026-10-27.
所排程的傳輸時間 in claim 1 is the only mention of 傳輸時間: a reference with no introduction. It used to flag under the wrong term 所排程. Claim-read 2026-10-27.

ADR-111 shift: 該所接收的訊息 was flagged as 所接收 (gold walker_fp); the capture now names 訊息. Claim 1 receives the message as the object of 接收 behind an unquantified relative clause, which TW does not yet read as an introduction; still a walker FP. Claim-read 2026-10-27.
Gold error under rulings R13/R14 (Christopher 2026-10-27). R13: 包含檢測…相對於對照的含量 introduces 含量 (article-less object of the step verb behind a relative clause). Claim-read 2026-10-27.

Gold error under rulings R13/R14 (Christopher 2026-10-27). R13: 接收經配置以收集生物樣本的器具 introduces 器具 (the article-less object of 接收 behind a relative clause); 由該第一及第二感測器產生的訊號 introduces 訊號 (R14 participle). Claim-read 2026-10-27.

Gold error under rulings R13/R14 (Christopher 2026-10-27). R13: 接收到從外部裝置輸入的讀取請求 introduces 讀取請求. Claim-read 2026-10-27.
Gold error under rulings R13/R14 (Christopher 2026-10-27). R14: 根據該顧客辨認裝置產生的代表資訊 introduces 代表資訊. Claim-read 2026-10-27.
